title: Grateful Dead Live at Salt Palace on 1981-08-12
source: flac16/48 Source Info:Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)Transfer Info:1st generation Reels (Technics RS-1506)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.01 > TLH flac2496. Mastered by Scott Clugston.

ai_review.summary: Good‑to‑great soundboard recording with a channel reversal quirk, highlighted by an extra‑slinky Althea.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as solid and enjoyable, especially the smooth, slinky rendition of Althea. The recording is a patched‑up soundboard source that sounds balanced overall, though listeners should be aware that the left/right channels are reversed and the tape has been pitch‑corrected. Despite these technical oddities, the set makes for a good listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; reviewer is overall positive about both performance and recording despite minor channel reversal issue.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Channels are reversed (Jerry's guitar on left), patch‑filled sections, pitch corrected; overall balance is solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on flow; reviewer notes the performance as a good listen overall.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar appears in left channel due to reversal; otherwise no specific musical comment.
